item.title: Flask Learning (1) - Introduction
item.description: 1. Introduction Flask was born in 2010 and is a lightweight Web application framework written in Python. Flask depends on two libraries. Jinja2, a template engine similar to mako Werkzeug, a Python library that follows the WSGI protocol and implements much of what sits underneath a Web framework, such as the request and response objects.
